title: SinkState: On-the-Fly SVD of Recurrent States for Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2611.14246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hybrid models combine softmax attention with linear attention, which compresses history into fixed-size recurrent states to balance model quality and inference efficiency. However, linear attention has not pushed this compression to its limit: we find that the queries, keys, and values of linear layers concentrate in a stable, low-dimensional subspace, a phenomenon we call the linear attention sink, so each state is effectively low-rank, with a rank that varies across states. Yet existing serving systems keep these redundant states dense, reading and rewriting them in full at every decoding step, so their memory traffic grows with the batch size and dominates the decoding cost. Thus SinkState stores each recurrent state in an adaptive low-rank form throughout inference with buffered updates and a local SVD restricted to the top subspace. SinkState further consolidates the remaining components asynchronously on the CPU. On four hybrid mod

translated_title: SinkState：基于循环状态即时SVD的高效混合大语言模型推理服务
translated_abstract: 混合模型将softmax注意力与线性注意力相结合，将历史信息压缩为固定大小的循环状态，以在模型质量和推理效率之间取得平衡。然而，线性注意力尚未将这种压缩推向极限：我们发现线性层的查询、键和值集中于一个稳定的低维子空间，我们将这一现象称为“线性注意力汇聚”，因此每个状态实际上是低秩的，且其秩在不同状态之间各不相同。然而，现有的服务系统将这些冗余状态保持为稠密形式，在每个解码步骤中对其进行完整的读取和重写，导致其内存流量随批处理大小增长并成为解码成本的主导因素。为此，SinkState在整个推理过程中以自适应低秩形式存储每个循环状态，采用缓冲更新和仅限于顶部子空间的局部SVD分解。SinkState还进一步在CPU上异步整合剩余的组件。在四个混合模……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SinkState发现线性注意力的查询、键、值集中于稳定的低维子空间（“线性注意力汇聚”现象），使循环状态实际呈低秩且秩随状态变化，并通过推理全程的自适应低秩存储与即时局部SVD分解，大幅降低混合大模型服务的内存流量和解码成本。
